title: Scorpion S1 and S5 first-pass diplomatic transcription
transcription_notes: This file contains a diplomatic layer: every cell has a unique position_id, so the underlying scan is not required for row/column ordering.
The family_label_v0_1 field is an exploratory visual family label, not a final normalized alphabet.
The family labels are intentionally useful for clustering and search, but they over-merge some variants relative to published unique-symbol counts.
S1 is given in the original 7x10 row-major layout.
S5 is given in the original 15x12 row-major layout. Nick Pelling's 16-column rearrangement was used only as a check on linear order and repeats.
The black strike-through between S5 rows 13 and 14 is not treated as a ciphertext row.
